data.title: Write and rewrite *in your voice*
data.subtitle: Good at #2: emails, posts, reports and the message you keep putting off.

items: Facts that must stay exactly as they are

blocks.text: Here's a message to [who]. Make it clear, polite and short. Keep my meaning and facts. Give me two versions, one warmer, one more formal, and say what you changed.

items: "Give me three other ways to open it."
"Write it for someone who's never heard of this."

blocks.old: Write a post about our launch.
blocks.new: Write a 120-word post for customers about our launch. Friendly, one call to action. Notes below.

items: It's your name on it: edit freely
